# boomi_data_integration_source_types (Data Source)

The catalog of source (datasource) types supported by the Data Integration API, read from the live API. Use it to discover the `id` that goes in a source-to-target data flow's properties.source.name, and the connection_type each source binds to. New sources appear without a provider release.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier for this catalog data source.
- `source_types` (Attributes List) All available source types, sorted by id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source_types))

<a id="nestedatt--source_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source_types`

Read-Only:

- `connection_type` (String) The connection type this source binds to (use with boomi_connection.type).
- `documentation_url` (String) Link to the source's documentation.
- `id` (String) Source type identifier (e.g. "mysql", "salesforce").
- `name` (String) Human-readable name (e.g. "MySQL").
- `section_id` (String) Catalog section/category id.
- `status` (String) Availability status (e.g. enabled, coming_soon, sunset).
